name: satisfaction-scores
title: Satisfaction scores
description: An overall score and category scores as labelled bars, the way buyers compare tools, with the source and a method link built in.
docs: Pass overall ({ score, max, responses, period }), categories ({ label, score }; five or six), source (required) and methodHref, plus an optional title and description. The overall number is plain, large text in tabular digits. Every category is a role="meter" with label, range and value, so assistive technology reads 'Ease of use, 9.4 out of 10' once and the drawing is left out of the reading. The server renders the bars full, and a list on screen when the page opens stays full; once the reader scrolls, a list still below the window fills its bars once, a little after one another, as it comes into view. Reduced motion and print show everything at rest. The source and the method link are part of the API on purpose: a score without them undermines itself. decimals sets the digits, locale the numbers, labels the fixed words.
